faq.title: Frequently asked questions.
faq.subtitle: Still have questions? Contact support by email.

items.question: What happens after the 2 free months?
items.answer: After the trial, your subscription is automatically charged to the card on file at R$10/month. You will receive a reminder email before the trial ends.

items.question: Do I need to enter a credit card to start?
items.answer: Yes, a card is required at signup to activate the trial. But there is no charge for the first 2 months. The first charge happens only after the free period ends.

items.question: Can I cancel anytime?
items.answer: Yes, cancel anytime with no penalty or fee. When you cancel, access continues until the end of the paid period. There is no minimum commitment.

items.question: Are my financial data secure?
items.answer: Your data is stored securely and is not shared with third parties. Only you have access to your financial information.

items.question: Does it work on mobile devices?
items.answer: Yes, Logos Finance is fully responsive and works on smartphones, tablets, and computers. Access it in the browser on any device without installing anything.

items.question: How does credit card control work?
items.answer: You register your cards with total limit and closing/due dates. The system tracks spending in real time, controls available limit, and helps you follow each bill amount.
